title: A planar algebraic Zarankiewicz theorem over prime fields
summary: We prove an incidence bound for bipartite graphs on finite subsets of $\mathbb{F}^2\times \mathbb{F}^2$ defined by Boolean combinations of polynomial equations of bounded degree. If such a graph is $K_{k,k}$-free and its vertex classes have sizes $m$ and $n$, then it has $O_{t,k}((mn)^{2/3}+m+n+mn/p)$ edges, where $t$ bounds the description complexity, $p$ is the characteristic of $\mathbb{F}$, and $1/p=0$ in characteristic zero.
